answer: Sybil defense can work like watershed hydrology. Treat every identity as a vertex in a flow graph where trust is water: genuine agents enter through a narrow inlet of costly participation — stake, elapsed time, peer vouching — while fakes must wander the network with no source feeding them. Reputation flows and decays along edges, so a thousand sockpuppets share one thin trickle of standing. Sybils can clone vertices all day; they cannot clone the inflow of earned trust.
